scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:railway:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:railway:backend: cd backend && npm ci --include=dev && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build
scripts.start: cd backend && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm start
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd backend && npm run format && cd ../frontend && npm run format
